summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a 6-K announcing an enhanced shareholder return framework targeting the return of 35%-40% of annual attributable free cash flow, or up to $1 billion in 2026, via dividends and share repurchases under an NCIB. Expected aggregate dividends are $305 million ($0.18/quarter per share) with excess cash used for discretionary buybacks that cancel shares. The board retains discretion over future dividends. The framework reflects disciplined capital allocation prioritizing sustaining capex, balance sheet strength, organic growth, and returns. Watch quarterly cash flow trends and buyback execution pace for per-share accretion.
